died.name: Unknown man
died.cause: The 32-year-old was driving a pick-up truck near Vacaville, California, when a motorist driving the opposite direction collided with a 750 lb cow that had stepped onto the road. The cow was sent airborne and struck the windshield of the pick-up driver, who died from massive head trauma. A third car crashed into the cow carcass, but was unharmed.
